deviations: V20 vs AR-1 R5 literal text: the recording_id CHECK '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$' is invalid in PostgreSQL (repetition bound max 255): every INSERT raised 'invalid regular expression: invalid repetition count(s)'. Found independently by this lane's IT and by B13 (docs/qa/evidence/STUDIO-OBS-013/b13/ledger.json). Replaced with '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'; varchar(256) bounds the length, so the accepted set is the same. IT: 256 chars accepted, 257 refused (too long), 'a/b' and '' refused. @architect to note in AR-1
autoDecisions: [AUTO-DECISION] Audit 'written only by triggers' is enforced with pg_trigger_depth() >= 2 on audit INSERT (reason: AR-2 says application code cannot skip the chain; this also stops it from forging rows)
[AUTO-DECISION] policies.active_version must be NULL on INSERT (reason: 'only to a version that has an approval row'; no version exists at insert)

[AUTO-DECISION] The session-policy freeze also requires observation_policy_hash = the version's hash and session scope.csiId = policy.csi_id (reason: consistency of the start-time freeze; no new semantics)
[AUTO-DECISION] No FK from policies/csi_guards csi_id to csi_systems (not in AR-2; publication tables do not FK csi either)

[AUTO-DECISION] Copy-table seeding in GuidedGovernanceMigrationIT uses session_replication_role=replica (CHECKs still on), because a prunable session (expires_at <= now-1h) can never pass V15 capture (expires_at > now). All assertions run at role=origin
[SUPERSEDED] The earlier policy key-set auto-decision is replaced by the C2b normative SQL (key names confirmed)
